description: Source code for TinyMCE preview plugin, defining plugin info, control HTML, and preview window behavior.

classes.name: TinyMCE_PreviewPlugin
classes.description: Object representing the TinyMCE preview plugin with methods for plugin info, control HTML, command execution, and window handling.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns plugin metadata including name, author, URL, and version.

methods.name: getControlHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML for plugin control button.

methods.name: execCommand
methods.description: Executes commands such as opening the preview window.

methods.name: _setDoc
methods.description: Sets the document object for the preview window.

methods.name: _setWin
methods.description: Sets the window object for the preview window.

methods.name: _onLoad
methods.description: Handles actions when the preview window loads, including embedding media.

methods.name: _writeFlash
methods.description: Embeds Flash media into the preview.

methods.name: _writeShockWave
methods.description: Embeds ShockWave media into the preview.

methods.name: _writeQuickTime
methods.description: Embeds QuickTime media into the preview.

methods.name: _writeWindowsMedia
methods.description: Embeds Windows Media into the preview.

methods.name: _writeEmbed
methods.description: Helper function to embed media objects.
